01 / Selection

The best tool is the one that improves a defined workflow.

Evaluate AI tools against outcome, context, integration, control and total operating cost — not the quality of the demonstration alone.

  • Outcome: which measurable revenue or operating result should change?
  • Context: what reliable data and knowledge will the tool use?
  • Integration: where will the output enter the actual workflow?
  • Control: who approves actions, manages permissions and reviews errors?
  • Cost: what implementation, review and maintenance work sits beyond the licence?

Tools we use in practice

These profiles reflect hands-on use within SmartLinks, combined with current official product information. They focus on operating fit, not feature lists.

Customer system and agentic architecture

HubSpot Agentic Platform

We use this as an architectural description of HubSpot's Smart CRM, Hubs, Agent Hub and governance layer — not as the name of a separate product edition.

Job
Create the shared customer context in which teams, workflows and agents operate.
Best when
HubSpot is already the source of truth and lifecycle, ownership and permissions are explicit.
Watch
Agent quality inherits portal architecture, data quality and access design.
Official HubSpot information →
Embedded AI execution

HubSpot AI Agents

Prospecting, customer-service and data agents can act inside existing customer workflows with the context already held in HubSpot.

Job
Perform bounded CRM work, surface context and move defined tasks forward.
Best when
The trigger, data, success measure and human hand-off are already defined.
Watch
Separate assistance, workflow automation and agent authority; audit every write action.
Official HubSpot information →
Voice and messaging execution

Aircall + AI Voice Agents

A conversation layer for handling, qualifying and routing calls and messages, booking meetings and returning outcomes to the customer system.

Job
Turn repeated inbound and outbound conversations into structured actions and data.
Best when
Intent patterns, escalation rules and CRM write-back are clear.
Watch
Disclosure, consent, language quality, edge cases, transfer design and unresolved queries.
Official Aircall information →
Prospecting, enrichment and outreach

Enginy AI

An integrated top-of-funnel environment for finding people and companies, enriching records, researching accounts, using signals and coordinating outreach.

Job
Build better account context and connect prospecting activity with the CRM.
Best when
ICP, list logic, lawful data use and the outbound motion are already defined.
Watch
Provenance, GDPR basis, deduplication, deliverability, message quality and attribution.
Official Enginy information →

How the field stack connects

LayerRole and data returned
Enginy AI
Demand intelligenceFinds, enriches and engages; returns contacts, account context, signals and activity.
HubSpot platform
Customer systemGoverns lifecycle, ownership, shared records, workflow state and reporting.
HubSpot AI Agents
Embedded executionActs on bounded CRM jobs; returns actions, exceptions and human hand-offs.
Aircall AI Agents
Conversation layerHandles and routes voice or messaging; returns transcripts, outcomes and next steps.

The useful unit is the closed loop: context enters the workflow, action happens within defined authority, the outcome returns to the customer record, and the system can measure what changed.

Also consider existing AI capabilities inside your current CRM, support, marketing, analytics and automation platforms before adding another system. The cheapest integration is often the one you do not need to create.

Match tools to the work

A category becomes relevant only when its foundation is present.

Job to improveFoundation required
Research and content preparationApproved sources, review criteria and audience context
CRM capture and next actionsClear lifecycle, fields, ownership and write permissions
Forecasting and deal riskConsistent opportunity process and sufficient historical signal
Prospecting and enrichmentDefined ICP, lawful data use and CRM deduplication rules
Cross-system automationStable process, exception handling and named technical owner
Autonomous agentsBounded authority, audit trail, escalation and quality monitoring
